name: GoAffPro
description: Run your GoAffPro affiliate program from your AI: find affiliates and their codes, see the orders, rewards and traffic they bring, what you owe and have paid them, and approve affiliates and commissions, add rewards and record payouts with confirmation.
instructions:
## GoAffPro
This connector calls the **GoAffPro admin API** (`https://api.goaffpro.com/v1/admin`) of one store's affiliate program: affiliates, the orders and rewards credited to them, what is owed and paid out, coupons, traffic and groups.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the GoAffPro admin of the store (from the Shopify, WooCommerce or other store app, or at https://app.goaffpro.com).
2. Open **Settings > Advanced > API Keys** and generate an access token.
3. Paste it into `GOAFFPRO_ACCESS_TOKEN` and install. It is sent in the `x-goaffpro-access-token` header, only to GoAffPro.

**Fields**: most list endpoints return only the fields you name. The tools default to a useful set (for affiliates `id,name,email,ref_code,coupon,status,created_at`); pass `fields` to ask for more.

**Tools**
- Affiliates: `goaffpro_list_affiliates`, `goaffpro_search_affiliates`, `goaffpro_get_affiliate_commissions`, `goaffpro_list_affiliate_coupons`, `goaffpro_list_affiliate_referral_codes`, `goaffpro_list_groups`.
- Sales and money: `goaffpro_list_orders`, `goaffpro_list_rewards`, `goaffpro_list_transactions`, `goaffpro_list_pending_payouts` (what is owed now), `goaffpro_list_payouts` (paid), `goaffpro_list_payout_requests`, `goaffpro_list_traffic`, `goaffpro_list_coupons`.
- Writes: `goaffpro_create_affiliate`, `goaffpro_update_affiliate` (approve, reject, commission, coupon), `goaffpro_add_affiliate_coupon`, `goaffpro_add_order`, `goaffpro_update_order` (approve or reject a commission), `goaffpro_give_reward`, `goaffpro_record_payout`, `goaffpro_update_payout_request`.
- Installed switched off: `goaffpro_delete_affiliate`, `goaffpro_delete_order`.

**Writes change what affiliates earn and see.** Name the affiliate and the amount or status and wait for the user's yes before any write. `goaffpro_record_payout` only records a payment made elsewhere; it never sends money.

**Paging**: affiliates, payouts, coupons and transactions page with `limit` and `offset`; orders, rewards and traffic with `since_id` (the last id of the previous page).

**Dates**: GoAffPro documents dates like `Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200`; the traffic filters use `2026-07-26T12:10:07`.

**Privacy**: affiliates, orders and traffic carry names, e-mail addresses, payout details and visitor IPs; ask only for the fields the question needs.

**Common errors**
- 403 `x-goaffpro-access-token missing from the headers`: GoAffPro says this for a wrong or deleted token too. Generate a new one under Settings > Advanced > API Keys.
- 400 or an `error` text: a required parameter such as `fields` is missing or a value is invalid.

**Out of scope here**: multi-level tree moves, groups and their members, special commission rates, creatives and assets, store configuration, webhooks and the affiliate-side (user and SDK) endpoints.

GOAFFPRO_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: GoAffPro access token
GOAFFPRO_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: GoAffPro admin > Settings > Advanced > API Keys: generate an access token for the store. Sent in the x-goaffpro-access-token header.
GOAFFPRO_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces or a header name.

verifyHints.403: GoAffPro refused the access token (it reports a wrong token as missing). Generate a new one under Settings > Advanced > API Keys and paste it again.

prerequisites: A store with the GoAffPro affiliate app and admin access to its settings, where API access tokens are generated. About 2 minutes.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_affiliates
tools.description: List the store's affiliates with the fields you ask for (default id, name, e-mail, referral code, coupon, status, created). Filter by ids, e-mails, referral codes, coupon codes, status (pending, approved, invited, rejected) or creation and update dates. Paged with limit and offset. Read-only.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (GoAffPro requires the list). Default id,name,email,ref_code,coupon,status,created_at; others include first_name, last_name, phone, country, website, instagram, group_id, ref_codes, coupons, payment_method, commission.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: pending, approved, invited, rejected.

created_at_min.description: Only affiliates created at or after this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

created_at_max.description: Only affiliates created at or before this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

updated_at_min.description: Only affiliates updated at or after this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

offset.description: Number of affiliates to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: goaffpro_search_affiliates
tools.description: Find affiliates by part of their name, e-mail or referral code (starts with, contains or ends with a keyword). Read-only.

keyword.description: Text to look for, e.g. anna or anna@.

in.description: Comma-separated columns to search, e.g. name,email,ref_code.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (GoAffPro requires the list). Default id,name,email,ref_code,coupon,status,created_at; see goaffpro_list_affiliates for others.

tools.name: goaffpro_get_affiliate_commissions
tools.description: Get the commission structure that applies to one affiliate: standard rate, special product or collection rates and royalties. Read-only.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_affiliate_coupons
tools.description: List the coupon codes assigned to one affiliate with discount type and value. Read-only.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_affiliate_referral_codes
tools.description: List the referral codes of one affiliate (the codes in their tracking links). Read-only.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_orders
tools.description: List the orders credited to affiliates with total, subtotal (the commission base), commission, affiliate and approval status. Filter by order ids or numbers, affiliate ids, customer e-mail, status (new, approved, rejected), creation date, new customers or subscription orders. Page with since_id. Read-only.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (GoAffPro requires the list). Default id,number,total,subtotal,commission,affiliate_id,status,created_at; others include customer_email, customer_name, is_new_customer, conversion_source, sub_id, data (the raw order).

number.description: Comma-separated order numbers as the shop shows them.

created_at_min.description: Only orders created at or after this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

created_at_max.description: Only orders created at or before this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

is_new_customer.description: 1 for orders of new customers, 0 for returning ones.

since_id.description: Only orders after this order id, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_rewards
tools.description: List rewards credited to affiliates outside of order commissions: sign-up, recruitment and target bonuses and upline sale commissions, with amount and status. Read-only.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (GoAffPro requires the list). Default id,affiliate_id,type,amount,status,order_id,metadata,created_at; these are the reward fields GoAffPro documents.

type.description: Comma-separated reward types: signup_bonus, sale_commission, recruitment_bonus, target_bonus.

created_at_min.description: Only rewards created at or after this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

created_at_max.description: Only rewards created at or before this. Date and time; GoAffPro's documentation writes it like Sun Jul 26 2026 12:10:07 GMT+0200.

since_id.description: Only rewards after this reward id, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_payouts
tools.description: List the payouts already made to affiliates (payment history) with amount, method, notes and date. Read-only.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (GoAffPro requires the list). Default id,affiliate_id,amount,currency,payment_method,admin_note,affiliate_message,created_at; add payment_details for the payout account data (personal data).

created_at_min.description: Only payouts created at or after this date.

created_at_max.description: Only payouts created at or before this date.

offset.description: Number of payouts to skip, for the next page.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_pending_payouts
tools.description: Show how much is owed to each affiliate right now (approved commissions and rewards not yet paid), optionally only up to a date. Read-only.

upto.description: Count only amounts earned up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_payout_requests
tools.description: List the payout requests affiliates sent from their dashboard, with amount, note, invoice and status (in_progress, paid, rejected). Read-only.

since_id.description: Only requests after this request id.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_transactions
tools.description: List the affiliate ledger: every credit and debit from orders, rewards and payouts with amount, currency, paid flag and running balance. Filter by affiliate, type or paid state. Paged with limit and offset; the answer carries count. Read-only.

type.description: Comma-separated entity types: ORDERS, REWARDS, PAYOUTS.

is_paid.description: true for paid, false for unpaid transactions.

payout_id.description: Only the transactions settled by this payout.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_traffic
tools.description: List visits that affiliates sent to the store, with affiliate, referring page, landing page and time, to see which affiliates drive traffic. Read-only.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (GoAffPro requires the list). Default id,affiliate_id,referring_page,landing_page,created_at; ip_address and user_agent are also available but are visitors' personal data.

created_at_min.description: Only visits at or after this, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.

created_at_max.description: Only visits at or before this, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.

since_id.description: Only visits after this visit id, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of visits, up to 1000.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_coupons
tools.description: List the coupon codes assigned in the affiliate app with discount type and value, affiliate and type (referral or personal). Filter by affiliate or code. Read-only.

type.description: referral for codes customers use, personal for the affiliate's own discount.

tools.name: goaffpro_list_groups
tools.description: List the affiliate groups (tiers) with their names and commission structures. Read-only.

tools.name: goaffpro_create_affiliate
tools.description: Create an affiliate account, approved or pending, optionally with a referral code, a coupon, contact data and a parent affiliate for multi-level programs. GoAffPro may e-mail the new affiliate depending on the store's settings. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

status.description: Approval status of the new account.

coupon.description: Optional coupon to create for the affiliate.

discount_value.description: A percent or an amount in the store currency.

parent_email.description: E-mail of the parent affiliate, for multi-level programs.

password.description: Optional initial password; leave out to let the affiliate set one.

ref_code.description: Referral code used in the affiliate's links.

admin_note.description: Private note visible only to the store admins.

personal_message.description: Message shown to the affiliate in their dashboard.

tools.name: goaffpro_update_affiliate
tools.description: Change an affiliate: approve or reject (status), personal commission rate, coupon, referral code, contact data or notes. Only the fields given are sent. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

commission.description: Personal commission that overrides the program's rate.

amount.description: Rate in percent or amount in the store currency.

coupon.description: Coupon to set for the affiliate.

ref_code.description: Referral code used in the affiliate's links.

admin_note.description: Private note visible only to the store admins.

personal_message.description: Message shown to the affiliate in their dashboard.

tools.name: goaffpro_delete_affiliate
tools.description: Delete an affiliate account. Installed switched off; turn it on deliberately. Rejecting with goaffpro_update_affiliate keeps the history. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

tools.name: goaffpro_add_affiliate_coupon
tools.description: Assign a coupon code to an affiliate. With only coupon_code, GoAffPro also creates the discount in the store according to the store's automatic coupon settings; with a discount type and value it records an existing store code for the affiliate. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

discount_type.description: Discount type of an existing code.

discount_value.description: Discount value of an existing code.

tools.name: goaffpro_add_order
tools.description: Credit an order to an affiliate by hand, e.g. a sale the tracking missed, by affiliate id or referral code. GoAffPro computes the commission from the store's rules. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

number.description: Order number as the shop shows it.

affiliate_id.description: Affiliate who gets the order. Give this or ref_code.

ref_code.description: Referral code of the affiliate. Give this or affiliate_id.

tools.name: goaffpro_update_order
tools.description: Change an affiliate order: approve or reject it, correct the commission or subtotal, or add a merchant adjustment. Only the fields given are sent. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

merchant_adjustment.description: Adjustment amount applied by the merchant.

tools.name: goaffpro_delete_order
tools.description: Delete an order and its commission from the affiliate's account. Installed switched off; turn it on deliberately. Rejecting with goaffpro_update_order keeps the record. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

tools.name: goaffpro_give_reward
tools.description: Credit a reward to an affiliate: a sign-up, recruitment or target bonus, or an upline sale commission for an order. The amount adds to what the store owes the affiliate. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

affiliate_id.description: The affiliate who gets the reward.

amount.description: Reward amount in the store currency.

metadata.description: A note stored with the reward, e.g. the reason.

tools.name: goaffpro_record_payout
tools.description: Record that an affiliate was paid (money sent outside GoAffPro, e.g. by bank transfer or PayPal), which lowers what the store owes them. Does not move money itself. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

payment_method.description: How it was paid, e.g. paypal or bank. Leave out to use the affiliate's own setting.

created_at.description: Date the payout was sent; now when left out.

tools.name: goaffpro_update_payout_request
tools.description: Set the status of an affiliate's payout request to in_progress, paid or rejected. Changes the live affiliate program: describe the change and get the user's confirmation before calling.

id.description: The payout request id from goaffpro_list_payout_requests.
